page: Microsoft Azure D32pds_v7 is an ARM-based general purpose virtual machine instance provisioned through Microsoft Hyper-V. The system is equipped with 32 dedicated vCPUs built on 64-bit ARM architecture and 128 GB of system memory, delivering a balanced ratio of 4 GB per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is absent, as the configuration contains zero GPUs. Storage capabilities include an integrated 1890 GB local NVMe SSD volume alongside support for Azure Premium Storage. The instance allocates zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses by default.

The inclusion of 1890 GB of direct-attached NVMe storage provides low-latency local I/O for temporary files, caching layers, and high-throughput scratch operations. Operating on ARM64 silicon provides power-efficient parallel throughput across all 32 dedicated cores. Trade-offs include the necessity for software stacks compiled for ARM64, the absence of x86 vector extensions, and the ephemeral nature of the bundled NVMe drive, which requires external managed disks or replication mechanisms for persistent data protection.

From an infrastructure perspective, the ARM architecture provides strong resource density and cost efficiency compared to legacy architectures for multi-threaded tasks. Microsoft Azure D32pds_v7 is suited for distributed web application tiers, relational database engines requiring fast local caching, containerized microservice deployments, large-scale software builds, and batch processing pipelines.
description: Microsoft Azure D32pds_v7 is a general purpose virtual machine providing 32 dedicated 64-bit ARM vCPUs and 128 GB of system RAM on Microsoft Hyper-V, maintaining a 4 GB per core allocation. The server includes 1890 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage and supports Premium Storage attachments, with no discrete GPUs and zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The ARM-based processor architecture offers resource efficiency and dense multi-threaded computation, countered by the requirement for ARM-compatible binaries and the temporary retention profile of local NVMe storage. D32pds_v7 is configured for enterprise application servers, intermediate caching systems, database workloads utilizing local scratch disk, and scalable microservice clusters.
